entities.summary: David Alexander Sharp Sisi is a German-born Italian professional rugby union player who primarily played lock for Zebre Parma of the United Rugby Championship. He had also represented Italy on 30 occasions at international level, having made his test debut against Scotland during the 2019 Six Nations Championship. Sisi has previously played for clubs such as London Irish, London Scottish, Bath, and Leeds Tykes in the past.
